title: Where can you fly direct from Belfast International Airport?
author: Matt
intro: Belfast International is easyJet's Northern Ireland base, with sun, city and UK routes, and Jet2 adds a big winter-sun programme. New this winter are direct flights to Rome and Sharm el-Sheikh. Here's what flies and how to choose.
seo_title: Belfast International: new Rome and Sharm flights (2026)
seo_description: easyJet flies most routes, now including Rome and Sharm el-Sheikh, and Jet2 covers the Canaries, Spain and Portugal. Direct routes checked Nov 2026.

sections.heading: The short answer
sections.text:
- **Main airline:** easyJet
- **Winter sun:** Jet2 and easyJet
- **New for winter 2026/27:** Rome and Sharm
- **Long-haul:** none direct

We checked these routes in November 2026. Routes and days of the week change every season, so check the airline's timetable before you plan a trip around one. And make sure you're looking at the right airport: Belfast City is a different airport with different airlines.

sections.heading: Belfast International or Belfast City?
sections.text:
Belfast International (code BFS) is the bigger airport, about 30 minutes north-west of the city near Antrim. It's where easyJet, Jet2 and most of the holiday flights go from.

George Best Belfast City (code BHD) is the smaller airport by the city centre. Its flights are mostly to Great Britain, with airlines like British Airways and Loganair. If you're looking for a sun holiday or a European city break from Northern Ireland, Belfast International usually has the most choice. Our guide to [how early to arrive at Belfast International](/blog/how-early-should-you-arrive-at-belfast-international-airport) covers security, the £5 drop-off and the Airport Express bus.

sections.heading: What's new
sections.text:
| Route | Airline | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Rome](/destinations/rome) (Fiumicino) | easyJet | Mondays and Fridays, all year, from 26 October 2026 |
| [Sharm el-Sheikh](/destinations/sharm-el-sheikh) | easyJet | Wednesdays and Sundays, from 25 October 2026 |
| Aberdeen | easyJet | Mondays and Fridays, from 4 January 2027 |

Rome is Northern Ireland's only regular year-round direct flight to the city, and Sharm el-Sheikh is its only direct flight to Egypt. On twice-weekly routes, the days decide your trip: Rome works neatly as a Friday-to-Monday weekend or a Monday-to-Friday break.

Watch out: UK visitors need a visa for Egypt, which you can get online or on arrival. Check the entry rules on GOV.UK before you book.

sections.heading: Winter sun
sections.text:
Most of the winter-sun choice comes from Jet2 and easyJet. Jet2's winter programmes from Belfast have included:

- The Canaries: [Tenerife](/destinations/tenerife), [Lanzarote](/destinations/lanzarote), [Gran Canaria](/destinations/gran-canaria) and [Fuerteventura](/destinations/fuerteventura).
- [Madeira](/destinations/madeira), for walking and gardens rather than beaches.
- Spain and Portugal: [Málaga](/destinations/malaga), Alicante and Faro for the [Algarve](/destinations/algarve).

The Canaries are the warmest of these in December to February, at about 20 to 22°C. Málaga and the Algarve are milder, at about 16 to 18°C, which suits walking and city days more than the beach. Add [Sharm el-Sheikh](/destinations/sharm-el-sheikh) if you want real heat and coral reefs.

sections.heading: City breaks
sections.text:
easyJet flies to a range of European cities from Belfast International, including several in France such as [Paris](/destinations/paris), [Nice](/destinations/nice), [Lyon](/destinations/lyon) and [Bordeaux](/destinations/bordeaux). [Kraków](/destinations/krakow) and [Barcelona](/destinations/barcelona) have also had direct flights.

Now that [Rome](/destinations/rome) is year-round, it's one of the best options for a winter weekend, with mild weather and short queues at the big sights compared with summer.

Tip: on routes that only fly a few times a week, check the timetable before booking hotels, so the flight days match the trip length you want.

sections.heading: Long-haul and connections
sections.text:
There are no regular direct long-haul flights from Belfast International. For the USA, Asia or the Caribbean, most people:

- **Connect through London**, with a short flight to one of the London airports.
- **Fly from Dublin**, about two hours by road, which has direct flights to North America with US pre-clearance before you board.
- **Connect through a European hub**, such as Amsterdam or Paris.

Booking the whole trip on one ticket means the airline rebooks you if the first flight is delayed.

sections.heading: Where could you go from Belfast International?
sections.text:
For a winter weekend, try [Rome](/destinations/rome) or [Paris](/destinations/paris). For a week of sun, look at [Tenerife](/destinations/tenerife), [Lanzarote](/destinations/lanzarote) or [Sharm el-Sheikh](/destinations/sharm-el-sheikh). The [Christmas holidays](/destinations/christmas-holidays) and [city breaks](/destinations/city-breaks) pages have more ideas.

If your family can't agree, read our guide to [deciding where to go on holiday](/how-to-decide-where-to-go-on-holiday), or add a few ideas to somewhere.party and let the draw decide.

faqs.question: Which airlines fly from Belfast International Airport?
faqs.answer: Mainly easyJet, which has its Northern Ireland base there, and Jet2, which flies to sun destinations. Check the airport's website for the full current list.

faqs.question: Can you fly direct from Belfast to Rome?
faqs.answer: Yes. easyJet flies from Belfast International to Rome Fiumicino on Mondays and Fridays, all year, from 26 October 2026.

faqs.question: Can you fly direct from Belfast to Egypt?
faqs.answer: Yes. easyJet flies from Belfast International to Sharm el-Sheikh on Wednesdays and Sundays from 25 October 2026.

faqs.question: Are there direct flights from Belfast to America?
faqs.answer: Not regular ones. Most people connect through London or a European hub, or fly from Dublin, which has US pre-clearance.
